c. 1950
The following is a faithful transcription of typed notes by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F. M.Cap.
AUTOGRAPH TO MYSTICAL CITY OF GOD, VOL III THE TRANSFIXION.
"HAIL Queen of the Heavens! Hail Mistress of Earth! Hail Virgin most pure of immaculate birth! Clear Star of the Morning in beauty enshrined; - O Lady ! Make speed to the help of mankind."
Glory be to God! From early childhood I had re- grettingly wondered why they had never written the life of the Blessed Virgin Mother Mary. I figured that since the life of any ordinary Saint is so in- spiring, what would not Her life be, who in Heaven and on earth is worshipt Queen of them all, so as to be Almighty God's own dearest Mother. Then a great poet who referred to Mary Immaculate as, "Humanity's solitary boast", wrote too:
"The lives of all great men remind us That we can make our lives sublime : And parting, leave behind us, worthy Foot-prints on the sands of time."
Childhood days and decades passed
Shortly after my ordination to the holy Priesthood I heard of a "LIFE OF THE BLESSED VIRGIN". I was skeptical. "Who could think of presuming to write the life of the Bl. V. Virgin these days ?! " So I figured; erroneously taking it for generally understood that it had never as yet, been written. However, I was determined to see if it possibly it might be more than a compilation of favors, etc, like the Glories of Mary" which my Father used to peddle in the winter-time and give away. .We found an abridged copy of
the Mystical City of God. WHAT A REVELATION ! What a treasure ! .. . From that first perusal of the simple but masterly introduction by the humble secretary, - the actual writer, - My conviction has grown, that the same, "Mystical City of God", of whose four volumns this present is the third; is, not only a genuine "Life of the same our B1. Mother Mary; but, having studied it for more than forty years and on my knees having prayed the whole four volumns I am convinced that the work has been rightly referrd to as the most opportune and authentic autobiography of the Bles- sed Virgin Herself, the Queen of all Creation and chosen by the divine Creator Himself to be His own Spouse and Mothi Glory be to God!
Poor Sinner
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Glory be to God.
